decisions.reason: This Requirement describes the separate main board in the multi-board design, while the added connector belongs to the integrated-board connector set.
Adding one required peripheral connector does not change the qualitative cost goal, component-tier preference, or elimination of interboard connectors.
The existing through-hole requirement already covers all connectors, and the source does not change the assembly type or its coverage.
This Requirement concerns the separate sensor board, and the source does not identify or alter any sensor-board connector.
The source adds a connector but specifies no placement, orientation, enclosure, edge-distribution, or RF-layout change.
The source does not identify J_DISP_LED or change any backlight circuit, supply, switching, or control requirement.
The omitted JST-GH connector could be the previously requested light-sensor port, but the source does not identify its purpose or I2C interface, so that relationship cannot be safely inferred.
The additional peripheral connector does not change the single-board architecture, functional consolidation, or functionality-preservation requirements.
The source does not alter charging behavior, voltage rails, battery efficiency, or the selected power-management component.
This Requirement concerns the panel power-button connector in the separate multi-board design, and the source does not identify that control or signal.
The added connector does not change the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of a separate INA device.
The source concerns an omitted JST-GH peripheral connector and does not change the ESP32 breakout header pitch.
